findings.title: renewals() casts every side action to a claim action
findings.detail:
`ds.map((d) => d.action as Extract<Action, { kind: "claim" }>)` relies on isSideAction meaning claim/renew. That holds today (packages/core/src/decide/receipts.ts:24), but the type does not enforce it.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally narrow with a type guard, or filter on kind === 'claim' && op === 'renew' at the call site.

findings.title: Evidence carries 1,621 lines derived from the gitignored trace
findings.detail:
AGENTS.md: 'Do not commit generated trace data'. This is a reduced extract kept as reproduce evidence under runs/, which norn commits, not the trace itself. It is still a large file in the PR.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: None required. A future reproduce could keep only the aggregate table.
